manualStand.cleanupCondition: Keep while physical listening review is pending; stop the owned stand when that review ends.

limits: Windows Chrome/Edge and GPU are desktop hardware; touch/viewport/DPR/CPU emulation does not certify Android, iOS, Safari, heat or battery behavior.
Latency tests inject metadata only; physical PCM output is not delayed, so Bluetooth synchronization is unverified.
Worklet captures digital mix before the host limiter. No clipping in these samples does not prove subjective sound quality.
Frame timings, pointer dispatch samples and bounded voices are engineering observations, not perception thresholds or heap-leak certification.

activeExceptions: Current 0.9.2 package and managed worktree support the remaining acceptance steps.
Manual stand 37167 and its temporary database remain active for physical listening.
Earlier user-loaded versions and other games are not cleanup targets.
